findings.problem: Component-level external links pull large unrelated content into every answer. The loader links every member to every external, and source_authority._closure() follows links transitively. The p63 ABS objects (be61e25b, f008b65a) and the p8/p27 fuel warnings (fd5a9183, b02f383c) already carry v4 dependency closures of 21-22 objects across pp18, 27, 63-66, 72-75, 112, 121-122, including the p121 troubleshooting table 15e1ce06...0448d2. All of it now flows into these two components. Simulated end to end: a draft claim citing only legend item '(7) Turn left - Left turn signal ON' (evidence_0f578049daa797b4bb00b976) gives a 34-object payload, and select() appends 18 mandatory displays (2,238 bytes) to the rider answer. These include starter-duration and cranking warnings, a starting PREREQUISITE ('Before an actual starting attempt, establish neutral ... clutch pulled in and held ...'), seven fuse warnings, EVAP overfill, fuel-approximation, refuel warnings and 'Have authorised service inspect and correct the brake system; failure risks serious injury or loss of life.' That last v4 display (bound to 26bf2297, p66) drops its printed condition, so in a turn-signal or high-beam answer it reads as an unconditional brake-fault instruction. A storage answer citing 'Cover the silencer...' (evidence_35e6dd9cd4df241c231eba9c) gets a 40-object payload and the same 14 unrelated displays plus the 4 battery ones. 'Do not use the motorcycle for long with the last fuel-indicator segment blinking; refuel at the earliest' and 'Failure to refuel ... fuel-pump damage' then sit beside the manual's 'Drain the fuel completely'. This is the misleading safety-text injection that check (c) asks about. It also invites verifier rejection as irrelevant content, which would disable both components.
findings.evidence_from_page: p62 legend (turn signals, high beam, ride mode, connectivity) and p120 storage list contain nothing about fuses, starting, cranking or refuelling. On p66 the brake-system sentence is conditional: 'If the ABS indicator lamp does not switch OFF and remains continuously ON at higher speeds ... Get the brake system inspected and corrected ...'. p120 instructs 'Drain the fuel completely from the fuel tank and induction system.'
findings.required_fix: Do not add any external whose own v4 closure goes beyond the intended object. For TELL_TALE_INDICATORS, drop the p63 externals and keep the ABS display self-contained on p62 evidence, e.g. cite d867f6c7 + bc21f201: 'Do not run the motorcycle if the ABS indicator lamp stays continuously ON; the legend notes it is ON during the initial check-up and turns OFF if the system is OK.' p63 stays reachable by its own retrieval in v4. For STORAGE_PRECAUTIONS, drop fd5a9183/b02f383c, keep the battery externals (clean 7-object closure), and add a review_note on evidence_660ca3000454e2f166858581 that the manual's fuel-system no-flame/no-spark guidance (pp6, 25) applies but is not linked. Alternatively change the loader so external links are terminal (the external object is included but its own links are not followed) with matching display handling. That is a loader change needing its own review. Either way, re-run the closure/display simulation and re-review.

findings.problem: The F1 display uses response_role CLARIFICATION. In the v10.13 response contract that role already means something else: AMBIGUOUS is 'only one focused CLARIFICATION claim' with clarification_question and RELEASE_CLARIFICATION (verified_qa.py ROLES, DRAFT policy, validate_draft lines 400-403). It is also a non-TECHNICAL role, yet the display states a technical specification (32 psi front and rear, both rows). Every suspension answer now carries a CLARIFICATION-role claim inside a SUPPORTED response. The verifier must mark it supported against fb5ddc13, whose own content shows 32 only at r2c3, so acceptance depends on the verifier honouring the review_note. Content is correct, but rejection would disable the component (fail closed, not unsafe).
findings.evidence_from_page: p117: merged 32 psi cell across Front/Rear and both rows.
findings.required_fix: Prefer a display role that the response contract does not reserve for rider clarification questions, and that is treated as a technical specification. This needs a loader role addition reviewed separately. Run one hosted verifier probe on a suspension question before relying on the overlay. Exclude the table only if neither is possible; exclusion would lose the 3rd/6th notch values that EXP040 needs.

The footnote is a brake-fluid 'Do not' instruction but still has no display.

findings.problem: Displays 2-3 come from a CAUTION box (p107) and display 4 from a NOTE (p104), but all are presented with response_role WARNING. The manual's own SAFETY DEFINITIONS give these levels different meanings: WARNING is risk of injury, CAUTION is damage to the motorcycle, NOTE is useful information. The display texts themselves are faithful. v4 uses the same convention, so this is not new in kind.
findings.evidence_from_page: PDF p6 (printed 4) SAFETY DEFINITIONS. p107 'CAUTION: Connect the red (+ve) positive terminal first ...'. p104 'NOTE: The poor contact or loose fitment of battery terminals may cause ECU failure.'
findings.required_fix: Accept as convention, or prefix the text with the printed level (e.g. 'Caution: ...') so the severity the rider sees does not exceed the manual's own.

findings.problem: The GVW and gross-weight-note externals bring in the whole v4 p20 DIMENSIONS/WEIGHTS component (12 objects) and its 3 displays. 'Listed values and dimensions are guidance only' and 'Specifications may change without prior notice' are appended to every suspension answer, where a rider may read them as applying to notch or psi values. Kerb weight 196 kg now sits beside the table's 'maximum of 196 kg payload', and GVW 394 minus kerb 196 gives 198, which invites an unsupported calculation.

findings.required_fix: Acceptable if kept. Add a review_note on fb5ddc13 or 0a41839a that payload must not be derived from GVW and kerb weight, and that the p20 'guidance only' note refers to the dimension values.

overall_note: Revision 2 (sha256 52867152d206abdd274355ce6e4665235c4270e64019214f739fce274b088a34) must not be approved. R2-N1 is blocking: two components' external links import unrelated v4 closures and 14-16 unrelated mandatory displays into rider answers. The v5 gate also requires open_findings == [] and every component approved. Text, membership, page labels, section paths (except the footnote) and all F1-F4, F6-F7 and F9-F15 resolutions check out against the pages. A revision 3 that removes or neutralises the transitive externals (and the fuel-display gap) needs a fresh review of TELL_TALE_INDICATORS and STORAGE_PRECAUTIONS, plus a re-run of the closure/display simulation. The minor items can be fixed in the same pass.
